resource.name: aws_db_subnet_group
resource.description: Provides an RDS DB subnet group resource. Hands-on: For an example of the aws_db_subnet_group in use, follow the Manage AWS RDS Instances tutorial on HashiCorp Learn.
resource.llm_summary: The `aws_db_subnet_group` Terraform resource enables the creation and management of RDS database subnet groups, which define a set of subnets within a VPC for hosting RDS instances. It is commonly used to ensure high availability and fault tolerance by distributing database instances across multiple availability zones. Users can configure subnet mappings, optimize network isolation, and support secure and scalable database deployments in cloud environments.

examples.title: Basic Usage
examples.llm_summary: "Demonstrates the basic configuration of an `aws_db_subnet_group` resource, including specifying a name, associating multiple subnet IDs, and applying tags for identification. This example shows how to create a database subnet group to define subnets for RDS instances in a VPC."

arguments.name: description
arguments.description: (Optional) The description of the DB subnet group. Defaults to "Managed by Terraform".
arguments.llm_summary: The `description` argument for the `aws_db_subnet_group` resource allows users to define a human-readable description for the DB subnet group, providing context or metadata about its purpose or usage. While optional, setting this argument can help document the resource's role within the infrastructure, aiding in organization and clarity, especially in multi-environment or collaborative setups.

arguments.name: id
arguments.llm_summary: The `id` argument in the `aws_db_subnet_group` resource allows users to specify a unique identifier for the subnet group, typically used to reference the resource in Terraform configurations or external systems. While optional, setting this argument can help ensure consistent identification and tracking of the subnet group across deployments and integrations.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: (Optional, Forces new resource) The name of the DB subnet group. If omitted, Terraform will assign a random, unique name.
arguments.llm_summary: The `name` argument for the `aws_db_subnet_group` resource allows users to define a custom, human-readable identifier for the DB subnet group, facilitating easier management and organization of database-related networking resources. If omitted, Terraform generates a unique name automatically, but specifying this argument is useful for aligning with naming conventions or distinguishing resources in multi-environment setups.

arguments.name: name_prefix
arguments.description: (Optional, Forces new resource) Creates a unique name beginning with the specified prefix. Conflicts with `name`.
arguments.llm_summary: The `name_prefix` argument for the `aws_db_subnet_group` resource allows users to define a custom prefix for the automatically generated name of the subnet group, ensuring uniqueness while avoiding manual name specification. This is particularly useful for dynamically creating subnet groups in environments where naming conventions or automation workflows require predictable yet distinct resource identifiers.

arguments.name: subnet_ids
arguments.description: (Required) A list of VPC subnet IDs.
arguments.llm_summary: The `subnet_ids` argument in the `aws_db_subnet_group` resource specifies the set of VPC subnet IDs where database instances can be deployed, enabling users to control the network placement and accessibility of their databases. By defining this argument, users ensure that the database operates within specific subnets, typically to meet security, availability, or connectivity requirements in their cloud environment.

arguments.name: tags
arguments.description: (Optional) A map of tags to assign to the resource. If configured with a provider `default_tags` configuration block present, tags with matching keys will overwrite those defined at the provider-level.
arguments.llm_summary: The `tags` argument for the `aws_db_subnet_group` resource allows users to assign metadata in the form of key-value pairs to the subnet group, enabling resource categorization, organization, and identification for purposes such as cost allocation, environment labeling (e.g., "dev" or "prod"), or compliance tracking. When set, these tags can override provider-level default tags with matching keys, ensuring granular control over resource tagging.

arguments.name: tags_all
arguments.llm_summary: The `tags_all` argument for the `aws_db_subnet_group` resource allows users to define a comprehensive set of key-value tags that are automatically merged from both provider-level default tags and resource-specific tags. This enables consistent tagging across AWS resources for purposes such as cost allocation, resource organization, and access management, aligning with common user goals like enforcing tagging policies or improving resource discoverability.

attributes.name: arn
attributes.description: The ARN of the db subnet group.

attributes.name: supported_network_types
attributes.description: The network type of the db subnet group.

attributes.name: vpc_id
attributes.description: Provides the VPC ID of the DB subnet group.
